data.name: Khizar
data.gender_notes: Khizar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Means the giver or the bestower. The name of a prophet in Islamic tradition who was given the ability to heal wounds. The name Khizar carries the meaning “Gifted, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Khizar usually hope their child will grow to embody gifted, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the giving and receiving of blessings.
data.etymology: Khizar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gifted, Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khizar total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: خضر
in_arabic.meaning: الخضر يعني الأخضر أو النبات الأخضر في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: الخضر هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، ويعني الأخضر أو النبات الأخضر، وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة الكهف، حيث يروي الله تعالى قصة سيدنا موسى عليه السلام والخضر عليه السلام، والذي كان شخصية غامضة ومحترمة في الثقافة الإسلامية، ويرتبط بالحكمة والروحانية

in_urdu.name: خضر
in_urdu.meaning: خضر کا مطلب ہے سبز یا ہرے پودے، عربی زبان سے ماخوذ
in_urdu.long_meaning: خضر ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے سبز یا ہرے پودے، یہ نام قرآن مجید میں سورة الكهف میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے، جہاں اللہ تعالیٰ موسیٰ علیہ السلام اور خضر علیہ السلام کی کہانی بیان کرتے ہیں، جو اسلامی ثقافت میں ایک پراسرار اور قابل احترام شخصیت ہیں، اور حکمت اور روحانية سے وابستہ ہیں

in_hindi.name: ख़िज़र
in_hindi.meaning: ख़िज़र का अर्थ है हरा या हरे पौधे, अरबी भाषा से लिया गया
in_hindi.long_meaning: ख़िज़र एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, और इसका अर्थ है हरा या हरे पौधे, यह नाम कुरआन में सूरह अल-कहफ़ में उल्लेखित है, जहां अल्लाह तआला हज़रत मूसा और ख़िज़र की कहानी बयान करते हैं, जो इस्लामी संस्कृति में एक रहस्यमय और सम्मानित व्यक्ति हैं, और ज्ञान और आध्यात्मिकता से जुड़े हुए हैं

in_pashto.name: خضر
in_pashto.meaning: خضر د معنی دی شین یا شنه پټی، د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی
in_pashto.long_meaning: خضر یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، او د هغه معنی ده شین یا شنه پټی، دا نوم د قرآن کریم په سورت الکهف کی ذکر شوی دی، چیرته چې الله تعالی د موسی او خضر کی داستان بیانوي، چی په اسلامی کلتور کی یو پراسرار او درناوی شخصیت ده، او د حکمت او روحانیت سره تړلی دی

in_english.name: Khizar
in_english.meaning: Khizar means green or vegetation in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Khizar is a masculine name of Arabic origin, meaning green or vegetation. It is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al-Kahf, which narrates the story of Prophet Moses and Khizar, a mysterious and revered figure in Islamic tradition. The name Khizar is associated with wisdom, spirituality, and guidance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Khizar holds a significant cultural impact in Islamic tradition due to the stories and teachings associated with the Prophet Khidr (as). One of the most popular and beloved narratives is the account of the Prophet Moses (as) and Khidr, which has been passed down through generations as an example of divine wisdom and encourages patience and trust in Allah. The story highlights the importance of humility and the unity of knowledge with faith. In many Muslim societies, the name Khidr is used as a symbol of Divine Guidance, Healing, and Wisdom.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Khizar signifies the Prophet's role as a bestower, not just of physical healing but also of spiritual guidance and wisdom. The Prophet Khidr (as) serves as an inspiration for Muslims to seek knowledge, seek the bestower's blessings and ultimately, come closer to God. The name further signifies the wisdom and deep understanding that comes from following Allah's command and SDahabah lessons from the Prophet's life. In this sense, the spiritual significance of the name is a reminder to always seek guidance and wisdom in Allah, and strive for knowledge that benefits both the self and others.
